about: The AI settings a site names itself, as both backends must read them: AI_FEATURES and AI_DAILY_LIMIT in .env (Node, loadAiSettings in server/config.ts), 'features' and 'dailyLimit' in config.php's ai block (PHP, AiConfig). Replayed by tests/unit/ai-config.test.ts and php/tests/ConfigTest.php. `env` is the variable's value (null: not set), `php` the key's value; a row without one of them is the other backend's alone. A refusal names the setting and never repeats its value. The default and the most a site may set are AI_DAILY_LIMIT and AI_DAILY_LIMIT_MAX in src/shared/ai.ts: both tests hold these rows to them.

accepted.name: both, in the app's order whatever order they are named in
spaces and a stray comma, as typed in .env

refused.name: a good name beside a bad one

accepted.name: the most a site may set

refused.name: zero: off is the switch's job
a number written as text in config.php
